# Merit Medical Systems, Inc.

> Explore Merit Medical&#039;s complete portfolio of disposable medical devices — designed and manufactured for interventional radiology, cardiovascular, endoscopy, oncology, dialysis access, and critical care procedures. Find products, IFUs, and clinical resources.

Canonical storefront: https://www.merit.com

## Catalog
- [All products](https://www.merit.com/products.json): public JSON catalog with price, availability, variants, and images.
- [Sitemap](https://www.merit.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL, including product pages.

## Policies
- [Shipping](https://www.merit.com/policies/shipping-policy): dispatch windows, regions, and rates.
- [Returns](https://www.merit.com/policies/refund-policy): return window, condition, and refund timing.
- [Privacy](https://www.merit.com/policies/privacy-policy): data collected and how it is used.

## Contact
- [Support](https://www.merit.com/pages/contact): human contact channel and response target.

## Machine notes
- Product pages carry schema.org Product JSON-LD with offers, price, currency, and availability.
- Autonomous shopping agents may read this site's public catalog and policy pages.
- Product identifiers include SKU so agents can match listings across merchants.
